Whakatāne – A place to explore

Welcome to our place – Whakatāne, New Zealand. Where the people are as warm as the sea and air; surrounded by breath-taking landscapes and rich culture. Immerse yourself in a sense of freedom, take your time and stay a little longer. A place to explore, to unwind, to be. 

He tangata, he whenua, haere mai - our people, our place, welcome.

Visit our website to find out more: http://www.whakatane.com
